purpose: Definition-only shared attribute vocabulary for simulated horses and people. No per-entity ratings, random seeds, careers, measurements, or historical claims are created here.

rules.all_horses: Every game horse carries the same applicable definition slots; individual latent ability, measurements and observed scouting evaluations are separate state layers.
rules.all_people: Every game person has common character traits and the union of the specialty traits of their assigned professional roles; irrelevant specialties are not forced onto a person.
rules.no_population: This file defines attribute names, scopes and meanings; it does not generate or assign values.
rules.latent_visibility: True underlying ability and heritable components are never directly exposed to player, AI horsemen or model-based market actors.
rules.scouting: Observed/evaluated ratings are evidence-bounded, may be null, and carry observer, confidence, last_observed_date and evidence references; observers can disagree.
rules.measurement: Physical measurements retain real units and dated evidence when available; do not substitute an invented qualitative rating.
rules.condition: Dynamic fatigue, fitness, health, form, morale, and other current states are recorded by the game run, not added permanently to historic canon.
rules.history: Canonical IDs and historical facts remain in the one approved source database; this catalog may be imported by generation/scouting/profile workflows without duplicating entity records.
rules.range: A player-facing numeric rating scale has not yet been approved; no 1–20 or 0–100 trait values are implied by these definitions.
rules.safety: Avoid pretending unverified horse medical conditions or personal moral judgments are facts about real historical individuals.

Speed & Pace.label: Raw Speed
Speed & Pace.meaning: Maximum sustainable race-speed capability under suitable conditions

Speed & Pace.label: Early Speed
Speed & Pace.meaning: Ability to accelerate and sustain pace leaving the gate and in the opening stages

Speed & Pace.label: Acceleration
Speed & Pace.meaning: Rate of reaching racing speed after the break or a tactical move

Speed & Pace.label: Cruising Speed
Speed & Pace.meaning: Efficiency and speed held at a manageable middle-race rhythm

Speed & Pace.label: Late Speed
Speed & Pace.meaning: Ability to deliver speed at the end after prior energy expenditure

Speed & Pace.label: Pace Resilience
Speed & Pace.meaning: Ability to handle early pressure without an exaggerated late fade

Speed & Pace.label: Pace Versatility
Speed & Pace.meaning: Ability to perform with different race shapes

Speed & Pace.label: Preferred Running Style
Speed & Pace.meaning: Natural tendency to lead, press, stalk, settle, or close; descriptive, not a quality score

Speed & Pace.label: Gate Break
Speed & Pace.meaning: Readiness, quickness and reliability at the start

Surface & Environment.label: Distance Profile
Surface & Environment.meaning: Performance curve across sprint, middle and route distances, not one universal best-distance score

Surface & Environment.label: Track Configuration
Surface & Environment.meaning: Adaptation to turns, banking, tightness and run-up geometry

Surface & Environment.label: Kickback Tolerance
Surface & Environment.meaning: Ability to maintain rhythm and composure behind dirt runners

Surface & Environment.label: Travel Adaptability
Surface & Environment.meaning: Tolerance for shipping, unfamiliar barns and unfamiliar surroundings

Physical & Biometric.label: Stamina

Physical & Biometric.label: Aerobic Capacity
Physical & Biometric.meaning: Ability to maintain repeated high-output efforts

Physical & Biometric.label: Muscular Power
Physical & Biometric.meaning: Power contributing to launch, drive and force production

Physical & Biometric.label: Stride Length

Physical & Biometric.label: Stride Frequency
Physical & Biometric.meaning: Actual stride rate in strides per second when measured

Physical & Biometric.label: Stride Efficiency
Physical & Biometric.meaning: Movement economy and useful conversion of stride dynamics into speed

Physical & Biometric.label: Balance & Agility
Physical & Biometric.meaning: Ability to corner, change leads and maintain efficient action

Physical & Biometric.label: Maturation Curve
Physical & Biometric.meaning: Individual developmental timing and growth trajectory

Physical & Biometric.label: Durability
Physical & Biometric.meaning: Longer-term physiological resilience; distinct from an injury diagnosis

Physical & Biometric.label: Recovery Capacity
Physical & Biometric.meaning: Ability to rebound after exertion and travel

Physical & Biometric.label: Soundness Vulnerability
Physical & Biometric.meaning: Underlying susceptibility to orthopedic problems, not a medical diagnosis

Physical & Biometric.label: Conformation
Physical & Biometric.meaning: Source-evidenced physical structure, measured/assessed rather than a single genetic magic number
